summary: Warm analog pad: ambient, deep house, lofi, R&B beds
label: warm pad
body: Long chords under everything, quiet. Airier: GeneralUser GS/Halo Pad; moving: GeneralUser GS/Sweep Pad; darker: GeneralUser GS/Atmosphere.

Register: MIDI 40-84 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Warm Pad, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Warm Pad") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
